boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Named public destinations along the Point Loma and Ocean Beach corridors west and north of campus.

cards.title: Sunset Cliffs Natural Park
cards.subtitle: Sunset Cliffs Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Use the linear section west of Sunset Cliffs Boulevard for a daylight walk; stay on established paths and observe the bluffs from designated public areas.
cards.short_summary: A city-managed coastal park with cliffs, arches, sea caves, and ocean views.
cards.evidence_claim: The City describes a linear 18-acre section west of Sunset Cliffs Boulevard between Adair and Ladera streets, with coastal bluffs, arches, and sea caves.
cards.source_title: Sunset Cliffs Natural Park | City of San Diego
cards.access_notes: Coastal bluffs are fragile; use designated public paths and follow posted conditions.

cards.title: Dusty Rhodes Park
cards.subtitle: Sunset Cliffs Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Check the City calendar before heading over for a scheduled outdoor movie, then bring a chair or blanket if the event listing calls for it.
cards.short_summary: A Sunset Cliffs Boulevard park used for City-presented outdoor movie programming.
cards.evidence_claim: A City event listing identifies Dusty Rhodes Park at 2469 Sunset Cliffs Boulevard and schedules a free outdoor movie there.
cards.source_title: Summer Movies in the Park at Dusty Rhodes Park | City of San Diego
cards.access_notes: Event programming is date-specific; verify the City listing before visiting.

cards.title: Robb Field Skate Park
cards.subtitle: Bacon Street corridor, reached from Sunset Cliffs Boulevard
cards.notes: Bring required skate safety gear if skating; spectators should remain outside the fenced area and all visitors should follow the posted City rules.
cards.short_summary: A City skate park with a bowl, rails, ledges, pump bump, and octagon volcano.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists a 40,000-square-foot concrete skate park at 2525 Bacon Street and specifies its street-course features and safety rules.
cards.source_title: Robb Field Skate Park | City of San Diego
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 10 a.m. to dusk, including holidays, according to the City; helmets, elbow pads, and knee pads are required for skaters.

cards.title: Robb Athletic Field
cards.subtitle: Bacon Street corridor, reached from Sunset Cliffs Boulevard
cards.notes: Use the City facility listing to identify an activity before going, such as tennis or the outdoor basketball courts, and confirm any reservation needs.
cards.short_summary: A municipal athletic complex with fields, courts, picnic space, and a skate park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Robb Athletic Field at 2525 Bacon Street with basketball courts, softball and multipurpose fields, tennis courts, picnic area, and other facilities.
cards.source_title: Robb Athletic Field | City of San Diego
cards.access_notes: Recreation-center hours vary by day; call the listed City contact for reservations or program details.

cards.title: Ocean Beach Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Santa Monica Avenue corridor off Sunset Cliffs Boulevard
cards.notes: Look up current recreation programming or use the listed courts and field areas during center hours; ask staff about reservable nearby parks if needed.
cards.short_summary: A City recreation center with indoor and outdoor basketball, a softball field, and community rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists the Ocean Beach Recreation Center at 4726 Santa Monica Avenue and identifies indoor/outdoor basketball courts and a lighted softball field.
cards.source_title: Ocean Beach Recreation Center | City of San Diego
cards.access_notes: Current City hours list Sunday as closed; check the facility page because times are subject to change.

cards.title: Point Loma Park
cards.subtitle: Catalina Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Bring a racket for the outdoor courts or check the City events calendar for scheduled park programming before making the Catalina Boulevard trip.
cards.short_summary: A Catalina Boulevard park with outdoor tennis courts and playing fields.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Point Loma Park at 1049 Catalina Boulevard with four outdoor tennis courts and identifies it as the site of Point Loma Summer Concerts.
cards.source_title: Point Loma Summer Concerts | City of San Diego
cards.access_notes: Concert listings are date-specific; verify the City calendar before visiting for an event.

cards.title: Cabrillo Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Cañon Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the center as a structured stop for courts or field time, and check its day-specific schedule before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A City recreation center with courts, fields, a play area, and a community building.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Cabrillo Recreation Center at 3051 Cañon Street and identifies basketball and tennis courts, a multipurpose field, softball field, play area, and community building.
cards.source_title: Cabrillo Recreation Center | City of San Diego
cards.access_notes: City hours vary by day and the center is closed Sundays and City holidays; times are subject to change.

cards.title: NTC Park
cards.subtitle: Cushing Road corridor at Liberty Station
cards.notes: Plan a daytime walk or field-based activity at this large municipal park, and use the City’s recreation contact if an organized-use permit is needed.
cards.short_summary: A 46-acre Liberty Station park with multipurpose, picnic, and special-event fields.
cards.evidence_claim: A City parks guide lists NTC Park at 2455 Cushing Road as a 46-acre site with multipurpose athletic fields, picnic and special-event fields, basketball, playgrounds, and comfort stations.
cards.source_title: Peninsula Parks and Recreation Program Guide | City of San Diego
cards.access_notes: For organized activities or reservations, use the City Parks and Recreation contact listed in the guide.

cards.title: Arts District Liberty Station
cards.subtitle: Truxtun Road corridor at Liberty Station
cards.notes: Start from the Truxtun Road buildings and use the district directory to select a gallery, studio, workshop, or performance that fits your schedule.
cards.short_summary: A Liberty Station arts district with studios, galleries, cultural organizations, and performance spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Liberty Station directory identifies Arts District tenants and locations along Truxtun Road, including arts studios, galleries, and performance spaces.
cards.access_notes: Individual studios, galleries, and venues have separate hours and may charge for specific programs; consult the directory before visiting.

cards.title: Cabrillo National Monument
cards.subtitle: Cabrillo Memorial Drive corridor
cards.notes: Begin at the visitor center, then choose a self-guided stop such as the lighthouse, Cabrillo statue, military exhibit, or Kelp Forest and Whale Overlook.
cards.short_summary: A National Park Service monument with historic, cultural, coastal, and interpretive destinations.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Park Service identifies easy walks from the visitor center to the Cabrillo statue, Old Point Loma Lighthouse, military exhibit, and Kelp Forest and Whale Overlook.
cards.access_notes: The monument is for day use and has an entrance fee; check NPS conditions before travel, especially for tidepool access.
